'''Easing the Badger''' is an inn in [[Illian (city)|Illian]] run by [[Nieda Sidoro]], one of the [[Blue Ajah]]'s [[Eyes-and-ears|eyes and ears]]. [[Moiraine Damodred|Moirane]], [[Lan Mandragoran|Lan]], [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]], [[Loial]], and [[Faile Bashere|Faile]] stop there as they are trying to catch up with [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]]. A group of [[Gray Man|Gray Men]] try to kill Perrin in the common room {{ref|Who sent the Gray Men? Not [[Sammael]] (Lord Brend), as he sent a Darkhound instead - and after Moiraine, not Perrin.}}, but he smells them in time to warn the others. After the attack and Moiraine's discovery that one of the [[Forsaken]] rules Illian, they leave early after only a few hours of sleep.{{ref|[[The Dragon Reborn]], [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 44|Chapter 42]]}}
